notes: Experimental Nano Letters paper on chemical reactivity of graphene on 2D substrates (UV/ozone, O2 plasma, HSQ e-beam hydrogenation), characterized by Raman, plus LDA calculations of H chemisorption energy. Hydrogenation is a reaction of hydrogen with no measured uptake: 'we introduced hydrogenation to graphene using electron beam (e-beam) lithography on hydrogen silsesquioxane (HSQ) resist' (main, p. 3, journal p. 321). The only gravimetric figure, 8.3%, is quoted from refs 26,27 (main, p. 5, journal p. 323). The Ar/H2 (9/1) anneal at 340 C is a residue-cleaning step, not an uptake measurement. Not theoretical_only (the paper has experimental Raman work) and not electrochemical (hydrogen comes from HSQ dissociation, not charging in electrolyte), so the I1 failure is coded no_conditions_stated. No retraction statement in the PDF; is_retracted is false; the paper is primary research; duplicate_data does not arise.
